summary: Move VM realtime usage into an expandable panel below the embedded and separate-window VM consoles, reusing the existing sampler and polling component. Historical VM charts and host realtime remain in Stats.

guide.reason: The VM realtime entry point moves from Stats to the console; explain simultaneous display/charts, collapse and navigation behavior.

api.reason: UI placement only: existing GET /api/v1/vms/{id}/stats?range=live and Controller-to-Core stats query/lease contracts, authorization, polling cleanup and responses are unchanged; no API reference change needed.

roadmap.reason: Placement improvement within delivered console/usage features; no public milestone or acceptance status changes.

state.reason: Drawer and enablement are transient browser state. Existing Core history and realtime sampling leases are unchanged; no new durable record.

verification.method: UI unit tests, TypeScript check and production build passed. The built-UI console browser fixture passed all nine checks against simulated API/RFB: embedded and separate consoles retain their canvas/session while expanding realtime, no polling before enablement, loading/empty samples, retained charts on errors and retry, Stacked, keyboard expansion, collapse/navigation stop, VM history-only Stats and retained host realtime. Desktop geometry verifies an unclipped console and complete first chart/legend; desktop and mobile captures were inspected. Both phase1 workflow copies already run the fixture on pushes and pull requests. Python compilation, documentation/privacy and diff checks passed; independent code review completed. Native usage_history_lab selectors were updated but the native lab was not rerun; no new host-sampling or deployed-build evidence is claimed.
